verdict.rationale: The pack contains no evidence of a split-inbox or categorized-stream feature (important, team, newsletters, invites) for priority-ordered triage. Several users say they miss Gmail's automatic categories and instead hand-build filters or use Sanebox. The 'Filters & Rules' doc is only a title, and user-built filter routing is an adjacent workaround rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can split my inbox into focused streams — important, team, newsletters, calendar invites — so triage happens in priority order, not arrival order
